That said, I think it would be worthwhile to come to some sort of consensus as to how the message should be spread.

My current method.

  1. Mention the WikiLeaks release of John Podesta's e-mail, with a brief explanation about WikiLeaks and Podesta, if necessary.
  2. Mention that people discovered strange e-mails that seemed to contain code speak. In particular, I shared the handkerchief with a pizza-related map e-mail, and the "P.S. Is it easier to play dominoes on cheese or on pizza?" I followed up by asking what that could mean, and explained that people claimed that pizza has been known to be a code word for child pornography and pedophilia. I further explained that on the surface, it could have been harmless, but that it led to people searching the e-mails further, which in turn led to the discovery of Comet Ping Pong and James Alefantis.
  3. Explain Comet Ping Pong (CPP) is a pizza restaurant in D.C., that is advertised as being family friendly. Further explain the unclassified FBI document regarding symbols frequently used by pedophile rings, and show the symbols that are used by a few businesses within the immediate vicinity of each other. I conceded that the symbols alone could be innocent (someone unwittingly using a spiraled triangle is understandable), but that there were so many usages of the symbols within such close proximity. I then explained that it caused people to dig further.
  4. Explain that CPP is owned by James Alefantis, who personally knows the Podestas, was the former partner of Brock, who was the head of CTR, and that he gets plenty of elite clientele. There is even a picture of Obama playing ping pong there on the Internet.
  5. Stress again that Alefantis and CPP were only discovered because of the curious Podesta e-mails.
  6. Show Alefantis' strange Instagram photos and his comments. In particular "hotard," "sex," the $1,200 baby, the child taped to the table, etc., etc. Explain that it isn't normal for a grown man to comment on baby photos to begin with, much less with what appears to be sexual innuendo. I have children and I rarely even comment when my wife posts photos of them on facebook; normal men aren't obsessed with photos of young children.
  7. Mention that on the CPP friends link, there was a band discovered called Heavy Breathing.
  8. Explain that Heavy Breathing is a band led by Amanda Kleinman (a/k/a Majestic Ape), and that videos can be found on YouTube of the bands music as well as being present at CPP. Explain/show the band's music videos and artwork which heavily contains pedophiliac innuendo.
  9. Show the YouTube video of Kleinman stating, "We all have our preferences."

*By now, you should know whether you have a hook. In my opinion, the Instagram photos and Heavy Breathing are the most damning pieces of evidence, and the people I shared it with thought there is probably something to them. I then added in a few more bits of evidence.

  1. I showed artwork done by the artist of CPP's walls, who painted stylized pictures of adults sexually abusing what is presumably children.
  2. I explained that Tony Podesta is John Podesta's brother, and showed the McCann police sketches.
  3. I showed the sculpture in Tony Podesta's house and compared it to the Dahmer crime scene photo, as well as the creepy paintings of children that he has.
  4. I explained that both Alefantis and Kleinman responded to this, claiming to be victims of conspiracy theorists, but not once did they explain their blatantly strange behavior.

I more or less ended it there, although I did explain Spirit Cooking to one person, without claiming that Podesta is a Satanist, but just stating that people like him and other politicians and Hollywood elites seem to enjoy degenerate performance "art." I also mentioned that there are a lot of speculations being made, and some or many of them could be false. I also cautioned that some of the speculations might be tinfoil hat conspiracy theories, but that they should just stick to the actual documented facts while researching Pizzagate.

I'm not claiming that my method is perfect by any means, and the route toward convincing someone about Pizzagate depends heavily on the target audience. That said, most people will be pushed away if it comes across as a tinfoil hat conspiracy theory. That is why I left out the possible link to the Clinton Foundation, etc. I don't believe that it would sell well by linking the Clintons to child trafficking, especially right after the election. Podesta's relationship with Hillary Clinton already indirectly taints Clinton, without having to go from 0-100 mph while introducing Pizzagate to a new person.

Once people think that something is off about those people, they will come across the other speculations if they start researching Pizzagate, and will be able to make their own decisions about the veracity of the speculations, without scaring them away from Pizzagate entirely. Frankly, I think that it hurts the cause to link Pizzagate to other established "conspiracy theories." Honestly, I get a bit triggered when I see people discussing the NWO, MK Ultra, the Satanic occult, Jews (seriously, please stop), etc. We have a diverse group of people here, some who delve more into "conspiracy theories" than others, but I think we should keep a narrow scope.
